description: This is a database migration script for the Apache Superset project, specifically fixing the 'form_data' field in 'query_context' within 'slices' that were stored as strings instead of dicts during migration.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing the 'slices' table with 'id', 'viz_type', and 'query_context' columns.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the migration to fix 'form_data' stored as a string in 'query_context' for specific visualization types.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: No operation; migration is not reversible due to data corruption fix.
